mapper.select: # SELECT * # FROM fx_orders_info # where order_status = 5 # and (supplier_id in # (select label from system_dict_data where dict_type = 'fx_business_entity' and color_type = 'info') # or # receive_supplier_id in # (select label from system_dict_data where dict_type = 'fx_business_entity' and color_type = 'info') # ) WITH supplier_filter AS (SELECT label FROM system_dict_data WHERE dict_type = 'fx_business_entity' AND color_type = 'info') SELECT * FROM fx_orders_info WHERE order_status = 5 AND ( supplier_id IN (SELECT label FROM supplier_filter) OR receive_supplier_id IN (SELECT label FROM supplier_filter) )

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fx_orders_info a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT c.order_id FROM fx_orders_detail c INNER JOIN fx_goods_archives d ON c.goods_id = d.ID INNER JOIN fx_sku_costprice b ON d.SKU_ID = b.sku_id AND b.TYPE = 0) sub ON a.id = sub.order_id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND sub.order_id IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fx_orders_info a INNER JOIN (SELECT b.order_id FROM fx_orders_detail b INNER JOIN fx_sk_boxsize c ON b.sku_id = c.sku_id AND b.count >= c.box_size WHERE b.order_id = #{id} GROUP BY b.order_id) sub ON a.id = sub.order_id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.erp_order_number, a.id, a.order_id FROM fx_orders_info a WHERE a.order_status = 3 AND a.warehouse IN ('11834410', '12169831', '11202095') AND a.is_to_erp = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fx_jst_order_out b WHERE b.o_id = a.erp_order_number)
mapper.update: UPDATE fx_orders_info t SET t.order_type = CASE WHEN LOCATE('一件代发单', t.remark) > 0 THEN 1 WHEN LOCATE('客商代发单', t.remark) > 0 THEN 2 WHEN LOCATE('销售退货单', t.remark) > 0 THEN 4 WHEN LOCATE('爱库存', t.remark) > 0 OR LOCATE('快团团', t.remark) > 0 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END, t.brand = (SELECT b.brand FROM fx_orders_detail a JOIN fx_goods_archives b ON a.sku_id = b.id WHERE a.order_id = t.id ORDER BY b.brand DESC LIMIT 1), t.order_status = 10 WHERE t.id = #{id}
